meta.title: About Us
meta.description: TrippGuru has guided over 10,000 pilgrims on sacred journeys since 2010. Based in Jodhpur, Rajasthan — licensed, insured, and devoted to safe pilgrimage travel.

hero.title: About TrippGuru
hero.subtitle: India's most trusted pilgrimage travel partner — guiding devotees on sacred journeys with safety, comfort, and devotion since 2010.

story.paraOne: TrippGuru was founded in 2010 by a group of devoted pilgrims who believed that every devotee deserves a safe, comfortable, and spiritually enriching yatra — regardless of age or physical ability.
story.paraTwo: Based in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, we have grown from a small local operator to one of India’s most trusted names in pilgrimage tourism. Over 10,000 pilgrims have completed their sacred journeys with us — from the snow-clad peaks of Kedarnath to the ghats of Varanasi.
story.paraThreeBefore: We are also proud to be associated with
story.paraThreeAfter: , our sister firm, together offering a comprehensive range of spiritual and leisure travel experiences across India.
assurances: Experienced guides with deep spiritual knowledge
Dedicated support team available 7 days a week

items.title: Devotion First
items.body: Every journey we plan is rooted in genuine devotion. We treat each yatra as a sacred responsibility, not just a tour.

items.title: Safety & Care
items.body: From vetted vehicles to experienced guides and 24/7 support, your safety is our highest priority throughout the journey.

items.title: Honest Service
items.body: Transparent pricing, no hidden charges, and honest advice. We believe in building trust through every interaction.

items.title: Reliability
items.body: Timely departures, confirmed bookings, and meticulous planning — so you never have to worry about logistics.

members.name: Rajesh Sharma
members.bio: A devoted pilgrim himself, Rajesh founded TrippGuru with a mission to make sacred journeys accessible, safe, and spiritually fulfilling for every devotee.

members.name: Priya Agarwal
members.bio: With over 10 years in pilgrimage tourism, Priya ensures every itinerary is flawlessly executed — from permits to accommodation.

members.name: Suresh Gupta
members.bio: A Kedarnath and Char Dham specialist with deep knowledge of Himalayan routes, rituals, and the spiritual significance of each shrine.

ctaCard.heading: Plan Your Yatra With Us
ctaCard.body: Whether you’re planning your first pilgrimage or your tenth, our team is here to make it safe, comfortable, and deeply meaningful.
